name: How do you prevent moisture damage in pool houses?

mainEntity.name: How do you prevent moisture damage in pool houses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elevate foundations 12-18" above grade, use cement board or fiber cement siding, install proper roof overhangs/flashing, and include exhaust fans in wet areas.
